mapper.insert: insert into interview_session (user_id, job_type, status, question_count, current_round) values (#{userId}, #{jobType}, #{status}, #{questionCount}, #{currentRound})
mapper.update: update interview_session set current_round = #{round} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into interview_message (session_id, round_no, role, content) values (#{sessionId}, #{roundNo}, #{role}, #{content})
mapper.select: select * from interview_message where session_id = #{sessionId} order by id asc
select count(*) from interview_message where session_id = #{sessionId} and role = #{role}

select s.id, s.current_round, s.started_at, (select m.content from interview_message m where m.session_id = s.id and m.role = 'CANDIDATE' order by m.id limit 1) as title, (select count(*) from interview_message m where m.session_id = s.id) as message_count from interview_session s where s.user_id = #{userId} order by s.id desc
mapper.delete: delete from interview_session where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
